items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There's Nelson Joseph and, uh, Kaiser was there. [INTERVIEWEE] Kaiser, played the clarinet, didn't he? Yeah. Oh yeah. And they had a tall fella in the band... I don't think he was in no relation to them.

ctx.x: Now, who had the outstanding reading bands here in New Orleans when you got here in 1919?
Well, Joseph, they tell me, did a lot of reading in the tuxedas.
